name: version-bump-capability-contract-inputs
title: Bump CLI version for capability contract proof changes
description: The current DONE version policy only bumps for watched CLI/runtime inputs. B-3a4d proved a user-visible CLI capability using docs/CLI.md plus packages/main/tests regression evidence, but DONE skipped the patch version because no packages/main/src file changed. Add a narrower policy so CLI capability contract/proof changes can bump the CLI patch version without expanding version bumps to every docs, experiment, or repository artifact change.
